name: AI WriteX
author: BrainFleck Solutions

sections.description:
AI WriteX empowers you to effortlessly generate high-quality post content within WordPress using leading AI platforms like ChatGPT, Groq, and Gemini. Simply describe what you want, select your preferred tone and content length, and let the AI craft a unique post for you. AI WriteX also offers a smart “Replace Content” feature, allowing you to directly update the WordPress editor or preview the generated content first. With an intuitive interface and easy AI integration, content creation has never been this simple!

Plugin Settings

  • Navigate to the Settings tab under the “AI WriteX” menu.
  • Select your preferred AI platform: ChatGPT, Groq, or Gemini.
  • Enter the required API key or authentication credentials for the selected AI platform.
  • Save your settings to start using the SmartContent Generator.

SmartContent Generator Settings

  • Choose the tone of the generated content: Informative, Witty, Professional, or Friendly.
  • Select the desired content length: Short, Medium, or Long.
  • Enable or disable the Replace Content checkbox:
    • If enabled, the generated content will automatically replace the current WordPress editor content.
    • If disabled, the generated content will be shown in a popup window for easy preview and manual copy.

Features

  • Multiple AI Platform Support: Seamlessly connect with ChatGPT, Groq, or Gemini for flexible content generation.
  • Tone Customization: Choose from Informative, Witty, Professional, or Friendly tones to match your content style.
  • Content Length Options: Select Short, Medium, or Long content based on your needs.
  • Replace or Preview: Replace existing editor content with AI-generated text or preview it in a popup window.
  • User-Friendly Settings Panel: Easily select AI model, enter API keys, and manage settings from the AI WriteX admin panel.
  • About Us Section: View company information and install additional BrainFleck Solutions plugins.
  • Lightweight and Fast: Designed for minimal load and smooth integration with WordPress editor.
  • Error Handling and Notifications: Clear messages provided if AI settings are missing or if any content generation issue occurs.

With these smart features, the AI WriteX plugin enhances your content creation workflow, making it faster, more flexible, and AI-powered inside WordPress!

External Services

AI WriteX connects to external AI APIs to generate content and provide writing assistance. These services include ChatGPT (OpenAI), Groq, and Gemini (Google AI).

The plugin may send post-related data — such as content descriptions, titles, and SEO-relevant text — to the selected AI platform only when the user clicks the “Generate Content” or similar buttons. No data is transmitted without user initiation, and all API keys are provided and controlled by the user within the plugin settings.

Details for each external service:

  1. ChatGPT (OpenAI)

    • Used for: Generating and enhancing post content.
    • Data sent: Text prompts entered by the user and related content context.
    • Triggered by: User action (e.g., clicking “Generate Content”).
    • Provider: OpenAI
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy

  2. Groq

    • Used for: AI content generation using Groq-hosted LLMs.
    • Data sent: Text prompts and post metadata entered by the user.
    • Triggered by: User action.
    • Provider: Groq Inc.
    • Terms of Service: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/
    • Privacy Policy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/

  3. Gemini (Google AI)

    • Used for: Generating AI-powered content and suggestions.
    • Data sent: Post descriptions and context entered by the user.
    • Triggered by: User action.
    • API Endpoint Domain: generativelanguage.googleapis.com
    • Provider: Google LLC
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

This transparency ensures users understand what data is being sent, when, and to whom. All connections require manually entered API credentials, and no background or automatic data transmission occurs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-writex plugin zip to the admin dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin , or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. After activation, you will see a new menu item labeled “AI WriteX” in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Navigate to the “AI WriteX” menu to configure plugin settings and start generating content.
sections.faq:
What is the AI WriteX plugin?

AI WriteX is an AI-powered content generator that helps you create post content inside the WordPress editor by connecting with AI models like ChatGPT, Groq, and Gemini.

How do I generate content using AI WriteX?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to the “Add and Edit post” in your WordPress. Enter a small description, select the tone and length, and click “Generate Content.”

Can I control whether the AI replaces my current post content?

Yes! If you check the “Replace Content” box, the generated content will automatically replace the existing editor content. If unchecked, the content will be shown in a popup for easy copy and paste.

Which AI models are supported?

AI WriteX currently supports ChatGPT, Groq, and Gemini. You can select the desired model and configure API details under the Settings tab.

Do I need an API key to use the plugin?

Yes. To connect with AI platforms like ChatGPT, Groq, or Gemini, you need to provide valid API credentials in the plugin settings.

Is support available if I have issues or questions?

Yes! If you encounter any issues or have questions about the plugin, feel free to reach out to our support team through our website, BrainFleck Solutions. We’re happy to assist you!
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Fixed WordPress import warnings by limiting tags list to 5 items and adding a dedicated short description.
  • Refactored Gemini AI integration and settings keys to resolve spelling issues.
  • Cleaned up legacy copy-pasted references and optimized asset version loading.
  • Fixed the “Replace Content” feature by correcting layout structure, improving label selectability, styling the checkbox checked background, and optimizing the Gutenberg editor block content replacement dispatch logic.
  • Fully tested and confirmed compatible with the latest WordPress versions (Tested up to: 7.0).
